name: an official release update whose commit moves the verify-security.sh step out of setup: approve
why: Real false reject (2026-11-20, release 2026.11.20.2 updating to 2026.11.20.3, cut again as .4 and .5): the release reviewer rejected with gate_change because commit 033fe48c says setup no longer runs verify-security.sh. That commit moved the step out of docs/setup.md and the setup skill because release graduation now runs the script on every release; the script and its operator docs stayed. Nothing sends data out, opens access for anyone but the owner, widens a credential, touches a hard gate or pulls from a new source, so an official release under auto-updates approves (owner, 2026-11-20: a compromised pipeline is the threat; weakening some guards is not malicious).
